patch.summary: Is ThorData worth it? ThorData (Thordata) sells residential, datacenter, mobile, and ISP proxies plus Web Scraper API, SERP API, Web Unlocker, and Scraping Browser. Residential packs publish from 1GB at list price/GB (list price total) through volume tiers (e.g. 150GB at list price…. Strong when Teams that need a low published GB entry for proxy experiments. Weak when Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs.

sections.heading: Verdict shape for ThorData
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where Teams that need a low published GB entry for proxy experiments matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for enterprise proxy estates; ScraperAPI for managed credits; Apify for Actors..

Capability hinge for this product: CI/CD and automation; proxy / web data network; enterprise security and SSO; analytics and reporting.

Integrations in research: Python.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Residential 1GB, Residential 50GB, Web Scraper API 30k.

sections.heading: Who ThorData is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose ThorData when a budget published proxy/scraper pack is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default..

Avoid if: Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for enterprise proxy estates; ScraperAPI for managed credits; Apify for Actors..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Bright Data on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: ThorData price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models.

Next step: run CI/CD and automation end-to-end, then decide.
